skill.name: receiving-code-review
skill.description: Guides AI coding assistants through code review feedback with verification, clarification, technical pushback, and careful implementation.
skill.summary: Evaluate code review feedback before acting, then clarify, verify, implement, and test each change.
skill.author: davila7

content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, excessive, or technically wrong. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to verify, clarify, and implement feedback carefully.
actual_capabilities: Structures review responses into reading, understanding, verifying, evaluating, responding, and implementing.
Encourages clarification before implementation when multi-item feedback is unclear.
Provides checks for external reviewer suggestions against codebase behavior and platform needs.
Defines when to push back using tests, code references, and architecture context.
Orders review fixes by blocking issues, simple fixes, and complex changes.
Promotes testing each fix individually and checking for regressions.
limitations: Does not run tests or inspect repositories by itself.
Does not replace human judgment for architecture or product decisions.
Does not provide language-specific or framework-specific review rules.
Tone guidance may need adaptation to team communication norms.

use_cases.title: Clarify Review Requests
use_cases.description: Use the workflow to restate unclear feedback and ask targeted questions before editing code.

use_cases.title: Challenge Risky Suggestions
use_cases.description: Check external reviewer advice against current behavior, tests, compatibility needs, and product scope.

use_cases.title: Sequence Review Fixes
use_cases.description: Prioritize blocking issues, simple fixes, and complex changes while testing each update separately.
use_cases.target_user: AI coding assistant users managing review iterations

prompt_templates.title: Review Feedback Triage
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a small review with clear comments.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. Triage this review feedback, identify what is clear, and list the first safe implementation step.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify Ambiguous Items
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for incomplete or numbered feedback.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. I understand some review items but not all. Restate the known items and draft concise clarification questions.

prompt_templates.title: Verify External Suggestions
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for feedback from a reviewer who may lack context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. Evaluate these external review suggestions against the codebase context, risk, compatibility, and existing behavior before proposing changes.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Review Implementation
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a larger review cycle.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the receiving-code-review skill. Build an implementation order for these review items, including verification steps, tests, and any technical pushback needed.

output_examples.input: Reviewer asks to remove a legacy path, but platform support may still require it.
output_examples.output: The response verifies target platform needs first, then either preserves the path with evidence or proposes removing unsupported behavior.

output_examples.input: A partner says to fix six items, but two items are ambiguous.
output_examples.output: The response pauses implementation, states which items are understood, and asks for clarification on the unresolved items.

output_examples.input: A reviewer requests a large professional feature that may not be used.
output_examples.output: The response checks actual usage, then recommends either implementing the needed scope or removing unused surface area.

best_practices: Clarify every unknown review item before editing code.
Verify external feedback against code, tests, compatibility, and product scope.
Implement one change at a time and report concrete results.
anti_patterns: Accepting every reviewer comment without technical verification.
Using performative agreement instead of clear technical response.
Batch-applying multi-item feedback without testing each change.

faq.question: Does this skill implement review feedback automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides the review response process and helps decide what to implement after verification.

faq.question: Can it help when feedback is unclear?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends stopping, restating what is understood, and asking focused clarification questions.

faq.question: Does it encourage disagreeing with reviewers?
faq.answer: It encourages technical evaluation. Pushback is used only when evidence shows the suggestion is wrong or risky.

faq.question: Is this useful for Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow is written for AI coding assistants that receive review feedback during development.

faq.question: Does it include security review rules?
faq.answer: It prioritizes blocking and security issues, but it is not a dedicated security audit checklist.

faq.question: What should users provide with the prompt?
faq.answer: Provide the review comments, relevant codebase context, constraints, and any decisions from the project owner.
